question: Before being elected as the 15th President of India, Draupadi Murmu was the Governor of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Jharkhand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Droupadi Murmu__

 __
 
• She was the Former governor of Jharkhand and tribal leader from Odisha, Droupadi Murmu.
 
• She was the first member of a scheduled tribe to be nominated for the position of President of India.
 
• The BJP-led NDA officially nominated her for the 2022 presidential race.
 
• Droupadi Murmu is serving as India's 15th president.
 
• She triumphed over Yashwant Sinha, the joint candidate for the opposition.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• She is the first President born in Independent India and the youngest person to hold the position.
 
• Before being chosen as president, she served in a number of cabinet positions for the Government of Odisha between 2000 and 2004.
 
• She was the ninth governor of Jharkhand from 2015 to 2021.
